title: I need some help because I am *completely* lost.

posts.author: Lard
posts.body:
I picked up RPG Maker MZ yesterday. I am a *complete* noob at this. I have *no* idea what I'm doing.
I have been able to make a basic map. I have been able to create a few characters.
That's as far as I can get. I have *absolutely* no idea what I'm doing. I'm trying to do basic things like just import my bloody character onto the map and I'm reading things about having to import four different files into four different places.....I am just totally lost.
Are there *any* tutorials that are basic for absolute new beginners like me? I am pretty frustrated right now, I thought this would be a lot more straightforward to use.
Any help is appreciated.

When you're asking questions like this, it's helpful to link to what you're talking about. I assume by "import onto the map" that you want the player to show up.
That should be included on the default map when you start a new project, and it has nothing to do with any files (never mind four files). If you mean something else, like customizing the image of the player, I would recommend you
not
do that yet.
If you're this new and having a hard time with the learning curve, limit yourself to learning the basic editor functions, not modifying any project files.
Lard said:
I am pretty frustrated right now, I thought this would be a lot more straightforward to use.
Click to expand...
I suggest you change that expectation. You're talking about making a video game, a complex piece of computer software.
An editor like RPG Maker can streamline a lot of the process for you, but it's still going to be something that requires technical knowledge and has a learning curve.
It's absolutely not wrong to ask for help, and there are a lot of resources and helpful people on these forums, but you also will need to be prepared to learn independently and take time looking things up in MZ's help file, Googling it, etc.
I don't say any of this to deter you, because anyone can learn how to use RPG Maker if they take the time to learn.
But I think it's best to have realistic expectations of the process, and if you're having this hard a time and this much frustration trying to figure out the most basic things, it's possible this kind of process isn't going to be enjoyable for you.
Good luck with your project!

posts.author: ISC
posts.body: I took a quick look online, and this seems like a good tutorial to get started. If you check how RPG Maker MZ works, it will be easier for you to learn. Try experimenting with every command available in an event, then continue step by step. Keep in mind that there are groups of commands that allow you to quickly create mechanics like transfers, treasure chests, and inns. However, before using these shortcuts, you should experiment with the basic commands first
